title: Well Hey There

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Well hey there, darlin, you come to dance?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well hey there, darlin, you come to dance?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Ah, not like the free love groups I used to swing with. But Delbs got his hands full trying to light fires across the city so I'm spending my time here. You should join me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, not like the free love groups I used to swing with. But Delbs got his hands full trying to light fires across the city so I'm spending my time here. You should join me!

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Oh it's not that hard. Have you seen some of the vids people upload to the feeds? Squirming around their bedrooms in swanky clothes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh it's not that hard. Have you seen some of the vids people upload to the feeds? Squirming around their bedrooms in swanky clothes?

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: That's the spirit! What's your go-to move? I'm a fan of fibbing with my hips, you know, like this. Boom-boom-botta. Boom-boom-botta.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the spirit! What's your go-to move? I'm a fan of fibbing with my hips, you know, like this. Boom-boom-botta. Boom-boom-botta.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: You just gotta feel the music, darlin. Let the lights shine on you like blazing suns and faded moons. I did a piece like that once. One of my favorite displays.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You just gotta feel the music, darlin. Let the lights shine on you like blazing suns and faded moons. I did a piece like that once. One of my favorite displays.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Oh, it was beautiful. The client was kind of a cockroach. Hard to believe they had much of a soul, but they wanted a celestial display that spanned a day/night cycle and I was happy to deliver.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, it was beautiful. The client was kind of a cockroach. Hard to believe they had much of a soul, but they wanted a celestial display that spanned a day/night cycle and I was happy to deliver.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Since I was a tot and my folks got me a plug-pin light up game. I'd make shapes with colored pegs and leave them on while I slept. They were beautiful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Since I was a tot and my folks got me a plug-pin light up game. I'd make shapes with colored pegs and leave them on while I slept. They were beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Darlin, if I wasn't already sweaty from dancin' you'd make me blush. You're quite the catch yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Darlin, if I wasn't already sweaty from dancin' you'd make me blush. You're quite the catch yourself.

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: A few things in the works. I gotta run out to Calypso in a few days to meet with a client. Hey! You should join me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A few things in the works. I gotta run out to Calypso in a few days to meet with a client. Hey! You should join me!

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Why not? They have some pretty chill beach clubs there. Could work on those moves of yours. Think about it, yeah? Ah! I love this song. Time to talk less and dance more!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why not? They have some pretty chill beach clubs there. Could work on those moves of yours. Think about it, yeah? Ah! I love this song. Time to talk less and dance more!

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: That's the spirit! Ahh! I love this song. Time to talk less and dance more!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the spirit! Ahh! I love this song. Time to talk less and dance more!

nodes.speaker: Reena ‘The Radiance’ Coda
nodes.text: Well, the invite's there if you change your mind!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, the invite's there if you change your mind!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's the ORS treating you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's the ORS treating you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not really much of a dancer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not really much of a dancer.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not really much of a dancer.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not really much of a dancer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd be embarrassed for people to see that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd be embarrassed for people to see that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd be embarrassed for people to see that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd be embarrassed for people to see that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If I could dance half as good as them I'd upload it too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I could dance half as good as them I'd upload it too.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I could dance half as good as them I'd upload it too.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If I could dance half as good as them I'd upload it too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Shimmie-shimmie.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shimmie-shimmie.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Stop. Lock. Hurt myself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stop. Lock. Hurt myself.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How long have you been a visual artist?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How long have you been a visual artist?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How long have you been a visual artist?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How long have you been a visual artist?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bet it pales to your beauty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bet it pales to your beauty.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Bet it pales to your beauty.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Bet it pales to your beauty.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you have any projects coming up?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you have any projects coming up?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you have any projects coming up?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you have any projects coming up?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Really?? Absolutely yes!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Really?? Absolutely yes!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want me to come with you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want me to come with you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You want me to come with you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You want me to come with you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can't, but thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't, but thank you.
